comment: Production npm pin for the separate Herdr 0.41.2 snapshot; core 0.41.2 (Pi 1.4.0 SDK set) is published to npm, verified from the registry. The downloaded registry tarball's independently computed sha512 equals dist.integrity and its sha256 equals the preserved accepted core artifact. This closes the herdr-checkout verification window the 0.41.2 candidate rode; no environment choice or acquisition fallback. Hosts moving from herdr-checkout to npm require explicit deactivate/activate, never inherited activation. Same-source settled npm installations may rebind under the plugin README's ownership conditions.
